task.description: Produce fix design artefact for LUA-11 (variable read/write) and LUA-13 (logging). Cover ExecutionContext fields trace_id/pending_writes/structured_logger, atomic apply/discard semantics, read-after-write, logging schema, ownership/lifetimes, error taxonomy, and test cases for LUA-11/13. DO NOT IMPLEMENT ZIG OR TESTS.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers ExecutionContext field additions (trace_id, pending_writes, structured_logger, instance_state) with lifetime + ownership rules
Design covers atomic apply-on-success / discard-on-failure semantics in executeSource
Design covers read-after-write behaviour for read_variable
Design covers LUA-13 structured-logging schema (timestamp, level, message, correlation IDs, optional context table)
Design covers error taxonomy (no new LuaError variants; existing set sufficient)
Design covers LUA-11 test cases (read, write, atomic-apply, atomic-discard for explicit fail + runtime error, ordering, read-after-write, table values, isolation, capability denial re-assertion)

result.summary: Design artefact src/design/iss0624-gh591-lua-11-13-fix.md covers LUA-11 + LUA-13 fix. Adds trace_id/pending_writes/structured_logger/instance_state fields on ExecutionContext (all defaulted for backward compatibility); implements atomic apply-on-success/discard-on-failure via a local-copy-and-pointer-install pattern (mirrors the existing LUA-10 active_watchdog approach). read_variable reads pending_writes first (read-after-write), then falls through to instance_state.variables. write_variable extracts the Lua value via a new extractValueInto helper (recursive tables, owned copies, integer-key rejection), stages in pending_writes. log builds a StructuredLogEntry from script args + ExecutionContext, calls StructuredLogger.log; adds a Writer function-pointer field to StructuredLogger (defaults to std.debug.print) for test capture. New test file src/lua/iss0624_lua_11_13_test.zig covers 21 named cases (12 LUA-11 + 9 LUA-13). Total production files touched: 5 (executor.zig + read_variable.zig + write_variable.zig + log.zig + structured_logger.zig -- matches diagnosis estimate). lint_design_artefact.py exits 0.

issues.description: Open question §9.1: instance_state default is a file-scope dummy_instance_state singleton (Zig 0.16 StringHashMap cannot be initialised to undefined in a struct literal; see §4.5). A cleaner design is a mandatory init() at every construction site -- the cost is ~8 line updates to existing test helpers. Recommend accepting §4.5's singleton for this run's scope; flagging as a follow-up if the singleton becomes a source of confusion in review.

Open question §9.2: extractValueInto rejects integer table keys with errors.LuaError.TypeError. Lua's table model allows them; StringHashMap(ScriptValue) does not. Alternative is stringification via tostring. Recommend strict rejection for this run; flagging as a usability follow-up.

Open question §9.3: StructuredLogger gains a Writer injection point -- this contradicts the diagnosis's 'verify-only' stance on structured_logger.zig. The injection is minimal (one function pointer field, default to existing std.debug.print); recommend accepting it because (a) it matches the LUA-12 HttpClientFn injection pattern, and (b) without it LUA-13 tests cannot capture entries portably across Zig 0.16 / Windows.
